claim_boundary: Concept-stage audit templates. Actor types are proposed and no institution, budget, procurement, performance, or implementation commitment is confirmed.

required_before_l1_l2_budgeting: G1 ownership, heritage, transport, utilities, fire, accessibility, and engineering clearance
site survey, equipment schedule, and bill of quantities
separate capital, annual operating, maintenance, removal, and reinstatement costs
professional reviewer, budget owner, procurement route, and restoration reserve identified

contracts.baseline_method: Two weekday and one weekend manual walk-through covering opening hours, queue, human-service availability, step-free route, notice comprehension, appeal access, and current digital prerequisites.
contracts.minimum_sample: 3 observation sessions plus 12 consented task walk-throughs, including at least 4 older or disabled participants; design target, not recruited evidence.
contracts.acceptance_record: RC-01 session sheet: timestamp, route, service mode, notice seen, human handoff seconds, barrier, appeal outcome, incident, operator signature, participant withdrawal flag.
contracts.evidence_retention: De-identified aggregate and signed incident/decision records for 12 months after G4; delete raw task notes within 30 days unless lawfully required.
contracts.pause_authority: site operator role type, with safety professional escalation

candidate_actor_confirmation.method: identify role through an authorised site/problem owner; verify mandate, conflicts, named delegate, insurance/liability route, pause authority, and replacement route

contracts.baseline_method: Survey public/test/logistics boundaries; tabletop-test emergency stop, observer separation, data path, equipment inventory, and human supervisor response.
contracts.minimum_sample: 2 stop drills, 2 boundary inspections, and 6 simulated test runs before any booked public test.
contracts.acceptance_record: RC-02 test permit: purpose, model/version, equipment, minimum data, observer line, stop owner, drill result, incident log, rollback receipt.
contracts.evidence_retention: Test plan, version, stop/incident and decision record for 24 months; no identifiable observer data retained by default.
contracts.pause_authority: test-site operator role type and named safety stop owner to be confirmed

candidate_actor_confirmation.method: identify role through an authorised site/problem owner; verify mandate, conflicts, named delegate, insurance/liability route, pause authority, and replacement route

contracts.baseline_method: G1 survey of ownership/use, fire egress, accessible route, operating hours, resident conflict points, noise, servicing, and existing public permeability.
contracts.minimum_sample: 3 time-period movement counts, 2 fire/egress reviews, and 1 documented resident/operator walk-through before opening simulation.
contracts.acceptance_record: RC-03 opening log: zone/time, capacity, egress clear, accessible route clear, complaint channel, noise/service issue, close/reinstate action, accountable signature.
contracts.evidence_retention: Aggregate counts and signed opening/incident records for 12 months; consultation records per consent notice and approved retention schedule.
contracts.stop_condition: basic passage or fire safety harmed
contracts.pause_authority: property or park operator role type, with fire/access escalation
dual_signoff: property or park operator role type
